initial.A:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete visual target for Broken Graveyard, a mature dark fantasy pixel RPG. Exact composition canvas 960x540, widescreen 16:9, full bleed, no border. Camera 3/4 overhead orthographic game camera, no horizon, no isometric diamond or diorama base. Native pixel art at 960x540: deliberate small 1px clusters, hard stepped edges, limited subdued palette, no antialiasing, no painterly blur, no outlines, no cast shadows. Upper left light expressed only by material face shading.
DIRECTION A — THE BROKEN WALLED COURT. Once ordered cemetery enclosed by low crumbling grey stone walls with sparse rusted iron railing. Enclosure visibly reaches the frame edges; not an island. Old rows of headstones confined to left and right perimeter; one sparse bare tree left perimeter. Mostly wet grey brown mud with broad restrained patches of pale olive dead grass, small low saturation grey puddles. Broken stone slabs form narrow incomplete paths ONLY, never a paved plaza.
Critical layout in 960x540 coordinates: unobstructed muddy combat ground x280..680 y95..315 (400x220), with no monuments trees or large stones inside. Keep this area visually quiet. Open collapsed human grave with broken stone rim at x730 y235, adjacent to right edge of combat ground, clearly a dark cavity with displaced lid; no skeleton. Headstones approximately 55-85px tall, low walls 70px, gate pillars about 120px relative to a future 96px tall human.
ONE entrance: broad unblocked gap at LEFT edge y260..345 with fallen open iron gate and muddy path entering. TWO exits: NORTH edge x470..570 a broken gate opening with path reaching top edge; EAST edge y145..235 clear crumbled wall breach with path reaching right edge. All three routes must visually continue beyond frame, wide enough for a human, separated readable negative-space openings. No other ambiguous walk-through gaps.
Bottom y325..540 is secondary cemetery foreground and wet earth, later covered by battle interface; all key openings and grave must be above y325. Theme: something after death failed to end correctly; order once existed but now fails. Exactly one subtle Fracture: left entrance slab path ends, resumes offset by 50px, with same slab cadence and no connecting bend. Normal terrain stays coherent. No glitch, cracks of light, pixel displacement, magic, text, runes, cyan, saturated blue, UI, actors or characters. No ground projection shadows. No solid black vignette. Beautiful quiet readable playable RPG screen, object boundaries distinguishable for future separation.
initial.B:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE complete Broken Graveyard visual target, native 960x540 16:9 full bleed. Mature dark fantasy TRUE pixel RPG scene. 3/4 overhead orthographic camera, no sky or horizon, no diorama platform. Deliberate native single pixel stair-step edges and compact pixel clusters, restrained 40-64 color appearance, no antialiasing, no outlines, no painterly rendering, no cast ground shadows. Light from upper left only through surface shading.
DIRECTION B — THE OPEN WIND-SWEPT GRAVE SLOPE. Radically unlike a walled courtyard: NO enclosing walls, NO fence enclosure, NO gates. A broad shallow hill of wet grey brown mud and sparse dead straw olive grass; grave rows climb obliquely toward a fog-obscured upper left bank. Boundary by dense ranked headstones, tangled low dead scrub and gently raised soil banks, not cliffs. Occasional worn headstones 55-85px tall relative to future human height 96px. One bare leaning tree at left rear, not in center. Foreground cropped graves imply cemetery continues outward. No neat geometric rectangular arena.
Reserve exactly x280..680 y95..315 as visually quiet unobstructed 400x220 combat ground. No gravestones, trees or big stones there. An open collapsed grave x730 y240 directly beside clearing, displaced lid dark cavity no skeleton. Predominantly mud, few grey low saturation puddles, no blue glows. Broken slabs only isolated remnants of thin old paths, never broad pavement.
ONE entrance at LEFT edge y260..340: narrow muddy lane through grass, then space unfolds. TWO exits: TOP edge x510..610 a climbing narrow path visibly cut through grave rows reaching frame edge; RIGHT edge y150..235 a descending muddy trail reaching frame edge, leading into low opaque muted grey mist. Distinct paths readable from inside clearing to edge, all key route openings above y325. Rest of perimeter occupied by graves or scrub and reads as scenery. Lower 40% secondary foreground earth and cropped graves for later UI.
Order failing: aligned grave rows progressively lean or sink at perimeter. Exactly one semantic Fracture: a short broken slab trail turns 90 degrees and ends facing the BACK of an isolated headstone, with no physical destination. This wrong relationship is quiet, not spectacular. No glitch, no RGB splitting, no cyan or saturated blues anywhere, no writing, runes, labels, UI, arrows, people, skeletons. No shadow silhouettes on ground. Leave center open while delivering beautiful somber low saturation muddy cemetery atmosphere.
initial.C:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-bleed 960x540 native pixel-art game screen, Broken Graveyard, mature quiet dark fantasy. 3/4 overhead orthographic camera, no horizon, no floating diorama base. Hard native 1px stair steps and carefully grouped pixels, limited subdued palette, no antialiasing, smooth brushwork, outlines or baked cast shadows. Light only from upper left through object face shading.
DIRECTION C — THE SUNKEN BURIAL YARD. Strongly different from open hill or courtyard: the muddy combat floor lies below surrounding burial terraces. Thick eroded earth banks with old exposed stone retaining faces define upper and side perimeter, 70-110px vertical height. Terraces occupy edges only; never a giant central pit or raised stone platform. Order survives as ranked gravestones on raised banks, some sinking and tilting. One restrained dead tree at upper left edge. Earthen walls and monuments distinct for later separation.
Critical upper-middle combat floor: x280..680 y95..315 a fully open quiet muddy area exactly 400x220, with only sparse low flat grass and tiny patches of standing grey water, no obstacles. Mostly wet grey brown mud, sparse desaturated dead grass; paving only broken small narrow path remnants. Human scale: future protagonist 96px tall, gravestones 55-85px tall, steps 8-10px rise. A clearly open collapsed grave at x740 y245 just east of combat ground, displaced heavy lid, dark soil cavity, no skeleton.
ONE entrance at LEFT edge y260..340: eroded gentle ramp slopes DOWN onto arena. TWO exits: NORTH edge x470..590 a broad broken stair leading UP out of screen with visible clear tread sequence; EAST edge y130..235 a second earthen ramp leading UP to right edge. Both remain visibly walkable beyond screen, no barred doorway. Fill all other edges with terrace banks and graves so these three gaps read clearly. Important grave, routes and clearing above y325. Lower 40% secondary muddy foreground, not a key landmark.
Exactly one subtle Fracture relationship: a short disused staircase at upper left ends against a blank earthen retaining face instead of reaching the terrace; it is not one of the working exits. No magical distortion, no glitch. Theme once ordered cemetery now losing order, death failed to end correctly. No cyan, saturated blue, luminous puddles, language symbols, text, UI, arrows, characters, bones or blood. No ground cast shadows. Rich but restrained clustered pixel materials, beautiful atmospheric readable RPG screen.
